scope: Android hybrid telemetry migration proof of concept; not a production release
reproduction: Set JAVA_HOME, ANDROID_HOME and ANDROID_SERIAL; run bash scripts/telemetry-hybrid-poc/verify.sh CORE_CHECKOUT TELEMETRY_CHECKOUT MESSAGING_CHECKOUT PRIVATE_MAVEN_DIR

pocs.name: mixed_capability_capture
pocs.result: Event observations, confirmed API entries and approved API outcomes remain distinct; old sinks retain fallback.
pocs.limits: An API or extension version alone does not establish outcome coverage.

pocs.name: shared_selector_retirement
pocs.result: Partial or entry-only declarations retain a shared selector; all reviewed members must declare outcomes before retirement.
pocs.limits: The catalog author must identify the complete API group; the POC cannot discover hidden callers.

pocs.name: core_configuration_sunset
pocs.result: Finalized Core configuration stops legacy projection without disabling business EventHub dispatch or direct API hooks; active calls retain their entry-time contract and mode.
pocs.limits: Collection permission remains authoritative; direct_only deliberately sacrifices unsupported legacy observations.

pocs.name: real_messaging_adoption
pocs.result: Two coalesced refresh calls produce two API entries and one observed request. Equivalent custom dispatch produces no refresh API entry. Local rejection and cache callback failure have explicit outcomes.
pocs.refresh_contract: entry_only; no network, message-delivery or business success/failure rate
pocs.getter_contract: cache_callback.v1; success, failure, rejected or actual callback timeout
pocs.evidence: Seven HybridTelemetryMigrationPocTests export approved synthetic records to application files/hybrid-telemetry-poc/*.json.

limitations: Only compatible Android POC branches were integrated; older Core, all-extension mixed versions, iOS and wrappers are not certified.
Missing completion is unknown/completion_not_observed, not timeout. Expiry is driven by new API entries or explicit maintenance/flush; independent idle scheduling is not implemented.
Worker handoff and pending state are bounded; overload can lose telemetry. Dropped handoffs are counted, but end-to-end completeness and performance are not established.
Fallback eligibility is evaluated by the worker; a queued observation can see newer migration declarations or mode. API operation metadata, unlike fallback eligibility, is pinned at entry.
The optional recorder uses POC schema 4/catalog 2; no production ingestion compatibility or failure-rate dashboard is certified.
A switch cannot upgrade applications that never adopt instrumentation. Permanent code removal requires a supported instrumentation floor or accepted coverage loss.
Capabilities and API group membership are trusted SDK metadata requiring review; invalid configuration selects direct_only for legacy fallback.
No full Android lint certification, production network, benchmark or downloaded-versus-programmatic configuration precedence experiment is claimed.
